title: Bento Circuit Defusal Quiz Overhaul (v0.4.24)
message: Overhauled the Grammar Landmine wired quiz mechanic with a modern Bento Circuit Defusal layout. Eliminated bracket artifacts, restored natural sentence flow with numbered indicators, and added tactile, color-coded interactive wire cards with real-time defusal feedback.
changelog:
• Bento Circuit Defusal: Replaced clunky square brackets [ ] with an unbroken sentence view featuring numbered markers (①, ②, ③, ④) and matching wire colors.
• Interactive Wire Cards: Redesigned the 4 wire choices into dedicated Bento cards with wire indicators, clear segment typography, cut actions, and spring touch physics.
• Real-Time Defusal Feedback: Cutting the faulty wire triggers immediate defusal confirmation with grammatical correction, while safe wires indicate harmless status.
• Lifeline & Session Support: Full Cross-Out lifeline and session pause/resume support for wire defusal cards.
